draft.emotion: a hollow and slightly surprised tone, noting the absence of something expected
notes: Before a noun, it usually takes の rather than な (e.g. 空っぽの箱, 'an empty box').
The kanji 空 alone is read から when meaning 'empty' (and そら when meaning 'sky'); 空っぽ is a more emphatic, everyday word for completely empty.
